question.text: SEBI (AIF) Regulations prescribe NAV disclosure frequency for Category III AIFs. What is the correct disclosure frequency?

answer.text: Monthly for closed-ended Cat III; quarterly for open-ended Cat III
Daily for both open and closed-ended Cat III
Quarterly for closed-ended Cat III; monthly for open-ended Cat III
Half-yearly for closed-ended Cat III; monthly for open-ended Cat III

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the SEBI AIF framework, NAV must be disclosed to investors QUARTERLY for closed-ended Category III AIFs and MONTHLY for open-ended Category III AIFs. The Trap: Option A swaps the two frequencies. Option B confuses the underlying valuation cadence with the mandated disclosure frequency. Option D understates the closed-ended cycle. Note: The disclosure frequency is set by AIF category and structure (open-ended vs closed-ended), not by the manager's internal valuation calendar.
